reply.summary: Llutareo is a weathered prairie farmer who pulls a bawling infant from a burning wreck on a country road and raises the child with his wife. His quiet decency and stubborn heart make him the moral anchor of a small farming town.

feats.scene: Llutareo heaves a smouldering wreck panel aside with both arms to reach the screaming child.
Llutareo endures scorching heat on his shoulders while carrying the child to safety.

reply.summary: Siullsil is a pale, white-haired bloodsucker who leads a cult of fanatical night-dwellers from a humid port town. He is strong, swift and nearly impossible to wound, yet daylight burns him to ash.

feats.scene: Siullsil punches through a stone wall of a cellar and drags a screaming captive through the hole.
Siullsil walks off a point-blank truck collision with only torn clothes.
Siullsil outruns a speeding car down a dark alley.

reply.summary: Arseo is a red-eyed, grey-haired sentinel of paradise, assigned to bar the gates to an invading army of ancient giants. Overconfident and lazy, he steps forward alone and is burned to the bone by a single blast.

feats.scene: Arseo swings a radiant spear and shatters a cliff face guarding the approach.
Arseo endures a searing bolt that chars him to the skeleton, yet the gate stands.
Arseo wheels across the sky above the gates faster than sound.

reply.summary: Estamo is a hulking clockwork giant forged by a vengeful inventor, built to parrot every order it hears. Its blind obedience makes it deadly in the lab and disastrous at the edge of a high window.

feats.scene: Estamo pounds a factory wall with iron fists and brings down a section of brickwork.
Estamo shrugs off a volley of pistol rounds and a swinging beam.

reply.summary: Urnstu is a reborn nightmare with black hair and, at times, no eyes at all, who stalks the sleeping world after an unhappy life ended in despair. She is both haunted and haunting, wearing a grin she once borrowed from a murderer.

feats.scene: Urnstu rakes a hand across a dreamer's bedroom and the walls peel away into screaming dark.
Urnstu absorbs a hail of broken glass in a dream and reforms without a mark.

reply.summary: Lesceore is a brown-haired citizen of a sunken kingdom, a husband and father living an ordinary life under the waves. He swims strongly and keeps his family close.

feats.scene: Lesceore hauls a heavy fishing net up onto the reef shelf.
Lesceore is knocked tumbling by a rolling current and swims clear.

reply.summary: Corresle is a red-eyed spirit of darkness sealed in a black gem, who leaps into the body of anyone who touches it. Once loose he reads minds, sows fear, hurls shadow blasts and calls storms, but light and lightning harm him.

feats.scene: Corresle looses a lance of black energy that flattens a row of barns and a water tower.
Corresle weathers a stampede of blasts that would topple a wall.
Corresle blurs across a field in a gale-driven rush.

reply.summary: Valcolti is a seven-foot red-haired, white-eyed fiend wreathed in flame, who has enforced the will of the underworld for ages alongside a twin. Rulers come and go, but he keeps his post and his taste for punishment.

feats.scene: Valcolti hurls a fist of fire into a gatehouse and reduces it to burning rubble.
Valcolti stands in a roaring blaze that melts the surrounding stone.

reply.summary: Riliont is a cheerful steam-train driver on a frontier line, shovelling coal and pulling the whistle cord with pride. With his brakeman partner and a lawman, he foils a gang of bandits eyeing the freight.

feats.scene: Riliont wrenches the throttle full open and sends the engine thundering into a barricade of ties.
Riliont rides out a lurching derailment scare in the cab and keeps his grip.

reply.summary: Stuvallu is a nervous brown-haired clerk at a broadcasting firm who quietly lifts company funds, always paying them back, until an anonymous extortionist catches him. He is more frightened than wicked.

feats.scene: Stuvallu shoves a heavy filing drawer shut with a loud bang.
Stuvallu stumbles on the office stairs and lands hard on his hip.

reply.summary: Stllco is a slick suit-wearing manager at a chemical conglomerate whose firm cuts corners with lethal results. He sits behind a glass desk and trusts paperwork over conscience.

feats.scene: Stllco slams a thick ledger onto a conference table and silences the room.
Stllco is shoved against a glass partition and slides to the carpet.

reply.summary: Titeres is a red-haired scoundrel from an advanced alien city who swaps places with a convicted twin and fakes flashy powers with a stolen belt. His bluff works until a scientist spots the trick.

feats.scene: Titeres floats above a plaza and heaves a stone fountain into a transport barge.
Titeres crashes out of a wrecked capsule and staggers away unhurt.
Titeres skims over rooftops on his borrowed lift-belt.

reply.summary: Cerer is a sour-tempered food reviewer, expelled from a fancy cruise dinner, who is suddenly filled by a strange force that lets him bellow with terrible power. His thunderous shouts hurl people across the deck until a stage magician ends it.

feats.scene: Cerer screams at a row of tables and flings a dozen diners across the ballroom.
Cerer is toppled by a counter-spell and lands face down on the carpet.

reply.summary: Lluliore is a red-eyed, hairless ring-bearer serving a galactic peace corps, willing and bold. His glowing band shapes solid light into walls, shields and weapons while a lantern recharges it.

feats.scene: Lluliore weaves a glowing ram of green light and smashes it through a fortress gate.
Lluliore raises a shimmering dome that withstands a barrage of artillery.
Lluliore streaks between planets at a staggering pace.

reply.summary: Satalre is a black-haired nineteenth-century newspaper man and storyteller, a foster child of a stern merchant, who gets drawn into a strange tale of masked justice. He survives by wit and a good ear for a ghost story.

feats.scene: Satalre swings a heavy ink pot and cracks a ruffian's knuckles.
Satalre tumbles down a cobbled alley bank and gets up with his notebook intact.

reply.summary: Cororamo is a tiny, bitter mind doctor whose scorned theories turn into terrifying psychic power. He sinks into dreams, bends wills and paints false visions over whole crowds, then makes heroes fight each other.

feats.scene: Cororamo seizes the minds of an entire school gym and sends them marching on the city hall.
Cororamo takes a hard slap to the cheek and tumbles across the stage.

reply.summary: Orlliniu is a bald mastermind in a cartoon crimewave, fond of gizmos shaped like his own shiny head. He schemes with bombs and trapdoors, but his pride blinds him to his own blunders.

feats.scene: Orlliniu detonates a giant novelty device and cracks the facade of a bank.
Orlliniu slips on his own slick floor and crashes into a cabinet.

reply.summary: Lliancor is a vain heavyweight prize-fighter who abuses his fame, then escapes justice through clever lawyers. A masked vigilante baits him into swinging in public, which ends his streak.

feats.scene: Lliancor throws a roundhouse hook that caves in a gym locker.
Lliancor absorbs a flurry of body shots from a sparring partner without a grunt.

reply.summary: Miasi is a black-haired scion of a notorious mastermind, living in a foggy old capital on the family name. He tries to inherit a dynasty of crime, plotting with more nerve than skill.

feats.scene: Miasi swings a walking stick and shatters a street lamp's glass.
Miasi is pushed into a brick wall and shakes it off with a sneer.

reply.summary: Anutecor is a rumpled, absent-minded inventor in a boarding house, always scribbling formulas and forgetting lunch. He lends gadgets and clever advice to a family of magic-fuelled champions.

feats.scene: Anutecor switches on a homemade coil and pops every bulb in the parlor.
Anutecor tumbles from a stool in his workshop and dusts off his coat.

reply.summary: Entlle is a blind, blond ex-soldier turned crime lord who runs a dragon-themed gang across two continents. His fighting skill is so sharp that sightlessness hardly matters, and a prisoner-born son carries his shadow.

feats.scene: Entlle snaps a hardwood staff through a rival's guard by sound alone.
Entlle takes a rifle butt to the ribs and answers with a pinpoint counter.
Entlle dashes across a dockside warehouse floor with sure footing.

reply.summary: Ntrniu is a fair-haired mad scientist in a pulp thriller who plots under an eerie nickname. His schemes last a single issue and end when a masked flier thwarts them.

feats.scene: Ntrniu sets off a coil-powered cannon and blasts a doorway out of a laboratory.
Ntrniu is knocked out cold by a heavy punch at the climax.

reply.summary: Olern is a bald sleuth who studies strange cases, and a member of a secretive circle of seekers. His patient deductions solve riddles that baffle the police.

feats.scene: Olern pushes a stuck window sash open and climbs out onto a ledge.
Olern slips on wet tile in a stakeout and takes the fall.

reply.summary: Teran is a bald, overworked marine researcher who stitches the cells of deadly sea creatures into a dying patient. His experiment works too well, and the monster he made turns on him.

feats.scene: Teran hurls a steel tray at a cabinet and rattles the glass.
Teran is thrown against a bulkhead by his own creation and does not rise.

reply.summary: Ialamneo is a warm black-haired scientist who runs a centre for gifted young people and worries about his own son. He solves problems with careful tests and patient talks.

feats.scene: Ialamneo hauls a heavy equipment case onto a lab bench.
Ialamneo is knocked over by a sudden tremor and rises unhurt.

reply.summary: Tiarern is a green-eyed mercenary hardened by a dreadful prison, who guzzles a potent serum to swell his muscles. Once a trusted soldier, he now leads a pack of hired guns and a campaign of terror.

feats.scene: Tiarern drives both fists through a steel shutter and rips the frame free.
Tiarern takes a speeding car's hit on the hip and keeps charging.

reply.summary: Vanone is a pink-haired hitman with a brain rewired by gangsters, who butchers his own family and then devours his victims' faces. His moods flip without warning, and he fires with deadly flair.

feats.scene: Vanone empties a pair of pistols and punches a line of holes through a thick door.
Vanone shrugs off a hard fall down a flight of marble stairs.

reply.summary: Teeorus is a hired killer from a tropical country who bends light, radio and heat to his will. His long career ends when a daughter he abandoned focuses sunlight on him.

feats.scene: Teeorus overloads a power substation with a surge of invisible energy and blacks out a district.
Teeorus tumbles through a window and comes up bruised but unbroken.

reply.summary: Ialiaamo is a white-eyed, white-haired fighter with a demonic edge, who battles in a war-torn alternate timeline to shield a continent from two warring armies. He is nimble and daring in the resistance.

feats.scene: Ialiaamo blasts a flaming kick into a tank turret and rips it off its ring.
Ialiaamo shrugs off a shell that cracks a barricade beside him.

reply.summary: Sorta is a wartime tank crewman riding a war machine said to be watched over by a phantom. He follows orders under fire and shares a heavy burden with his father's name.

feats.scene: Sorta fires the tank's main gun and shatters an enemy bunker's front wall.
Sorta sits inside a hull that takes a shell on its armour and rings like a bell.

reply.summary: Lesco is an eight-foot, red-maned beast, a scholar changed by touching a space rock into a rampaging cat-man bent on ruin. Cold air at great height shrinks him back to a mild-mannered digger of old tombs.

feats.scene: Lesco rips a museum door from its frame and hurls it down the steps.
Lesco absorbs a spear through the gut and fights on.
Lesco bounds across a plaza on all fours at the pace of a sports car.

reply.summary: Lonileon is a towering, red-maned lion-man who prowls as a hired criminal for a band of villains. Claws, fangs and rapid healing make him a fearsome brawler.

feats.scene: Lonileon swipes a claw across a parked truck and rips it open like a tin can.
Lonileon shrugs off a point-blank volley of rifle fire.

reply.summary: Cosaunu is a widowed, brown-haired tycoon in a grim alternate tale where evil gets the upper hand. He guards his empire and his daughter with cold calculation.

feats.scene: Cosaunu slams a hand down on a boardroom table and the decision stands.
Cosaunu is shoved off balance by an angry creditor and recovers.

reply.summary: Veast is a wiry, brown-haired government operative turned freelance soldier who learns to trust an outlaw archer. He becomes a father figure to the archer's son and keeps a wry sense of humour.

feats.scene: Veast kicks open a reinforced door and drops two guards in one motion.
Veast takes a hard hit in a warehouse brawl and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Olumon is a scientist whose accident lets him melt into a living shadow, desperate for a cure from a cruel patron. He slips through gaps and strangles victims, but sunlight and bright lamps destroy him.

feats.scene: Olumon rises from the floor in shadow form and hurls a guard through a glass wall.
Olumon is caught in a flood of bright light and burns away.

reply.summary: Soreon is a black-haired small-time gang boss hungry for power, who hides his crew of masked enforcers behind a self-help dojo. He tests an unstable serum on his followers and plots a heist against a rich family.

feats.scene: Soreon snaps a board with a swift chop in front of his rapt recruits.
Soreon takes a boot to the chest in the dojo and bounces up smiling.

reply.summary: Nausirn is a by-the-book police detective in a sprawling western city, wary of lawyers and loopholes. He reins in a headstrong warrior ally with patient talk and procedure.

feats.scene: Nausirn tackles a fleeing suspect over the hood of a squad car.
Nausirn takes a punch to the jaw during an arrest and holds on to the cuffs.

reply.summary: Seteroro is a covert operative of a chessboard-themed agency, sent on a ruse to snare a masked archer. His plan nets a quick scuffle and a hard shock from a stun gun.

feats.scene: Seteroro throws a fast jab at a masked opponent and clips his shoulder.
Seteroro is hit by a stun dart and drops to the pavement.

reply.summary: Amorlan is a green-eyed puzzle-loving genius in a mirror world, a widower who leads a hidden resistance against ruling tyrants. He fights from the shadows with traps, codes and plans.

feats.scene: Amorlan triggers a hidden charge that drops a tunnel ceiling onto a pursuing patrol.
Amorlan is dragged across stone by a patrol and still sends his signal.

reply.summary: Naseter is a red-haired thief with a limp and a hooked cane, drawn to jobs that others call impossible. His motives baffle even hardened villains, who urge him to leave town.

feats.scene: Naseter cracks his cane across a guard's wrist and snatches the parcel.
Naseter is shoved against a railing and clings on with a grimace.

reply.summary: Lecorse is a brown-haired prankster-genius in a mobile-game universe who trades threats for rhymes. He rallies with a cane and gadgets and, in a pinch, sings a silly chant at ancient horrors.

feats.scene: Lecorse swings his cane and sends a gadget-laden drone crashing into a wall.
Lecorse is shoved aside by a rampaging brute and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Eonnu is a tall black-haired mastermind who cannot stop leaving clues for the law at every crime scene. He tries to cure the habit by conditioning but is caught again and again by a famous pair of vigilantes.

feats.scene: Eonnu triggers a giant trap-device that smashes a museum hall's display cases.
Eonnu falls into a river and is hauled out still smirking.

reply.summary: Sotiaent is a dark-haired schemer left near death by a savage lizard-like beast that is hunting every rogue in town. Torn half through and unconscious, he lies in a hospital bed under guard.

feats.scene: Sotiaent raps his staff against a table to command a room's attention.
Sotiaent survives a mauling that would kill most men and clings to life.

reply.summary: Laniam is a black-haired inventor mocked by a sporty father, who turns to safecracking and then brain-boosting devices. After a lab disaster, he fills a rival's house with traps and sets out on a campaign of deadly games.

feats.scene: Laniam detonates a puzzle-bomb that blows out the front of a mansion.
Laniam is hurled across a rooftop and clutches a ledge.

reply.summary: Rnveo is a mocking tricksterly criminal in a reimagined story, carrying a staff in the shape of a hook. He ends his run in a bitter final chapter.

feats.scene: Rnveo cracks his staff over a thug's shoulder with a loud thump.
Rnveo is flung into a bin by a rival and climbs out grinning.

reply.summary: Lennusval is the son of a puzzle-loving schemer in a grim possible future, known only by his name on a headstone. His link to a masked guardian remains a secret in the asylum grounds.

feats.scene: Lennusval is remembered for slamming a tin lid on a rusty gate.
Lennusval falls to a sudden blow and does not rise.

reply.summary: Talreo is a red-haired electronics wizard from a rough district, scarred by a brutal giant, who rebuilds himself with cold circuitry and glowing eyes. A loyal boyhood friend of a masked hero, he crashes crime networks with a few keystrokes.

feats.scene: Talreo overloads a city server hub and every light along the waterfront bursts.
Talreo's cybernetic frame absorbs a heavy crash from a falling shipping container.

reply.summary: Naanura is an American criminal, a minor figure in a strange retelling set at a holy-night tableau. He lurks among the shadows and plays little part in the main story.

feats.scene: Naanura swings a cane and cracks a lantern off its hook.
Naanura is shoved to the straw floor of a stable and scrambles up.

reply.summary: Ianiaam is a black-haired psychiatrist in a swinging-sixties alternate city, known for steep fees and a clever book of word games. A gentle questioner, he helps a grieving young woman face her guilt.

feats.scene: Ianiaam closes his thick book with a clap that startles his patient.
Ianiaam is jostled in a crowded foyer and keeps his composure.

reply.summary: Liunau is a brown-eyed lab technician with a split mind, who turns from awkward colleague to cold, boastful killer leaving puzzles at each crime. He plots bombings and chess-themed murders, sometimes allied with a smooth crime boss.

feats.scene: Liunau wires a bomb beneath a bridge toll plaza and collapses the whole span.
Liunau is knocked off his feet by a blast and crawls away.
